topics.name: Epilepsy Fundamentals and Localization
topics.blurb: Seizure classification, semiology, substrates, and the definition of drug-resistant epilepsy.

topics.name: Presurgical Epilepsy Evaluation
topics.blurb: Noninvasive and invasive workup that localizes the epileptogenic zone before resection.

topics.name: Resective and Ablative Epilepsy Surgery
topics.blurb: Temporal and extratemporal resections, disconnection, and laser ablation with outcome metrics.

topics.name: Neuromodulation for Epilepsy
topics.blurb: Palliative stimulation devices VNS, RNS, and DBS-ANT for drug-resistant seizures.

topics.name: Movement Disorders Surgery
topics.blurb: DBS, lesioning, and focused ultrasound for Parkinson disease, tremor, and dystonia.

topics.name: Trigeminal Neuralgia and Cranial Neuralgias
topics.blurb: Diagnosis and surgical management of trigeminal neuralgia, hemifacial spasm, and related syndromes.

topics.name: Neuromodulation and Ablation for Chronic Pain
topics.blurb: Spinal cord stimulation, intrathecal drug delivery, and ablative procedures for refractory pain.

topics.name: Spasticity Surgery
topics.blurb: Intrathecal baclofen, selective dorsal rhizotomy, and chemodenervation for upper-motor-neuron spasticity.

topics.name: Psychiatric Neurosurgery
topics.blurb: DBS and ablative procedures for OCD and depression, and the ethics of psychosurgery.

topics.name: Stereotactic Radiosurgery Principles
topics.blurb: Radiobiology, dose-fractionation, delivery platforms, and functional indications for stereotactic radiosurgery.

topics.name: Emerging Functional Technologies
topics.blurb: Focused ultrasound, closed-loop stimulation, and brain-computer interfaces shaping future functional neurosurgery.

concepts.name: Drug-resistant epilepsy definition
concepts.blurb: Failure of two tolerated, appropriately chosen antiepileptic regimens to achieve sustained seizure freedom; triggers surgical referral.
acgme: Seizure Classification and Pathophysiology (ILAE 2017)

concepts.name: ILAE 2017 seizure classification
concepts.blurb: Classifies seizures by onset (focal, generalized, unknown), awareness, and motor features to guide diagnosis and therapy.
acgme: Seizure Classification and Pathophysiology (ILAE 2017)

concepts.name: Seizure semiology and localization
concepts.blurb: Ictal signs (aura, automatisms, version) localize the symptomatogenic zone and hint at the epileptogenic region.
acgme: Seizure Classification and Pathophysiology (ILAE 2017)

concepts.name: Temporal lobe epilepsy
concepts.blurb: Most common surgically remediable epilepsy; mesial type features auras, automatisms, and hippocampal seizure onset.
acgme: Temporal Lobe Epilepsy - Surgical Evaluation and Lobectomy

concepts.name: Mesial temporal sclerosis
concepts.blurb: Hippocampal neuronal loss and gliosis; the classic substrate of drug-resistant mesial temporal lobe epilepsy.
acgme: Temporal Lobe Epilepsy - Surgical Evaluation and Lobectomy

concepts.name: Focal cortical dysplasia
concepts.blurb: Malformation of cortical development (ILAE types I-III) and a leading substrate of extratemporal drug-resistant epilepsy.
acgme: Epilepsy Lesionectomy (Cortical Dysplasia Cavernoma Tumor)

concepts.name: Lesional epilepsy
concepts.blurb: Seizures from an identifiable lesion (cavernoma, tumor, dysplasia); MRI-visible substrate favors good resective outcomes.
acgme: Epilepsy Lesionectomy (Cortical Dysplasia Cavernoma Tumor)
Tumor-Related Epilepsy - AED Selection and Perioperative Management

concepts.name: Status epilepticus management
concepts.blurb: Continuous or recurrent seizures requiring staged benzodiazepine, antiepileptic, and anesthetic escalation to prevent neuronal injury.
acgme: Status Epilepticus - Recognition and Treatment Protocol

concepts.name: Antiepileptic drug pharmacology
concepts.blurb: Mechanisms (sodium channels, GABA, SV2A), spectrum, interactions, and enzyme induction guiding seizure pharmacotherapy.
acgme: Antiepileptic Drug Pharmacology - Mechanisms and Interactions

concepts.name: Video-EEG monitoring
concepts.blurb: Phase I scalp monitoring captures habitual seizures to confirm epilepsy and localize ictal onset noninvasively.
acgme: Presurgical Epilepsy Evaluation (Video-EEG Wada Test fMRI)

concepts.name: Epilepsy-protocol MRI
concepts.blurb: High-resolution thin-section MRI with hippocampal views detects mesial sclerosis, dysplasia, and other epileptogenic lesions.
acgme: Presurgical Epilepsy Evaluation (Video-EEG Wada Test fMRI)

concepts.name: Interictal FDG-PET
concepts.blurb: Interictal hypometabolism marks the epileptogenic region, especially when MRI is non-lesional or discordant.
acgme: Nuclear Imaging - SPECT and PET in Neuro-Oncology and Epilepsy

concepts.name: Ictal SPECT and SISCOM
concepts.blurb: Ictal perfusion tracer injection shows hyperperfusion at seizure onset; SISCOM coregisters it to MRI for localization.
acgme: Nuclear Imaging - SPECT and PET in Neuro-Oncology and Epilepsy

concepts.name: Magnetoencephalography
concepts.blurb: Magnetic source imaging localizes interictal spikes with high spatial resolution to plan resection or invasive electrodes.
acgme: Presurgical Epilepsy Evaluation (Video-EEG Wada Test fMRI)

concepts.name: Neuropsychological testing
concepts.blurb: Baseline memory and language profiling predicts cognitive risk of resection and supports lateralization.
acgme: Presurgical Epilepsy Evaluation (Video-EEG Wada Test fMRI)

concepts.name: Wada test
concepts.blurb: Intracarotid amobarbital lateralizes language and assesses contralateral memory reserve before dominant temporal resection.
acgme: Presurgical Epilepsy Evaluation (Video-EEG Wada Test fMRI)

concepts.name: fMRI language and memory mapping
concepts.blurb: Task-based functional MRI noninvasively lateralizes language, increasingly replacing the Wada test in many centers.
acgme: Advanced MRI - Spectroscopy Perfusion Functional MRI in Neurosurgery

concepts.name: Stereo-EEG
concepts.blurb: Stereotactically placed depth electrodes sample deep and bilateral networks to define the epileptogenic zone three-dimensionally.
acgme: Stereo-EEG (sEEG) - Indication and Technique

concepts.name: Subdural grid and strip electrodes
concepts.blurb: Craniotomy-placed surface electrodes map contiguous cortex and enable extraoperative functional mapping, at higher morbidity than SEEG.
acgme: Invasive EEG - Subdural Grid and Strip Electrode Placement

concepts.name: Phase II invasive monitoring strategy
concepts.blurb: Choosing invasive monitoring when noninvasive data are discordant; SEEG for deep/networked hypotheses, grids for contiguous superficial mapping.
acgme: Invasive EEG - Subdural Grid and Strip Electrode Placement

concepts.name: Intraoperative cortical mapping
concepts.blurb: Electrical stimulation maps eloquent motor and language cortex to define safe resection margins.
acgme: Intraoperative Cortical Mapping (Motor Language) for Epilepsy or Tumor

concepts.name: Anterior temporal lobectomy
concepts.blurb: En bloc resection of anterior temporal neocortex with amygdalohippocampectomy; standard cure for mesial temporal lobe epilepsy.
acgme: Temporal Lobe Epilepsy - Surgical Evaluation and Lobectomy

concepts.name: Selective amygdalohippocampectomy
concepts.blurb: Targeted resection of amygdala and hippocampus sparing lateral neocortex, aiming to reduce neuropsychological morbidity.
acgme: Selective Amygdalohippocampectomy

concepts.name: Engel and ILAE outcome scales
concepts.blurb: Standardized postoperative seizure-outcome classifications (Engel I-IV, ILAE 1-6) for reporting epilepsy surgery results.
acgme: Temporal Lobe Epilepsy - Surgical Evaluation and Lobectomy

concepts.name: Surgery vs medical therapy evidence
concepts.blurb: Randomized trials (Wiebe 2001, ERSET) show temporal lobectomy markedly superior to continued medical therapy for seizure freedom.
acgme: Temporal Lobe Epilepsy - Surgical Evaluation and Lobectomy

concepts.name: Epilepsy lesionectomy
concepts.blurb: Resection of an epileptogenic lesion (dysplasia, cavernoma, tumor) with surrounding cortex when warranted to achieve seizure control.
acgme: Epilepsy Lesionectomy (Cortical Dysplasia Cavernoma Tumor)

concepts.name: Laser interstitial thermal therapy
concepts.blurb: MRI-guided stereotactic laser ablation of mesial temporal or focal lesions; minimally invasive alternative to open resection.
acgme: Epilepsy Lesionectomy (Cortical Dysplasia Cavernoma Tumor)

concepts.name: Corpus callosotomy
concepts.blurb: Disconnection of the corpus callosum, palliative chiefly for drop attacks in generalized or multifocal epilepsy.
acgme: Corpus Callosotomy for Epilepsy

concepts.name: Anatomic hemispherectomy
concepts.blurb: Removal of an entire hemisphere for catastrophic unilateral epilepsy; high efficacy but greater blood loss and hydrocephalus risk.
acgme: Multi-Lobar Resection and Hemispherectomy for Epilepsy

concepts.name: Functional hemispherotomy
concepts.blurb: Disconnection rather than removal of a hemisphere, achieving similar seizure control with less resection-related morbidity.
acgme: Multi-Lobar Resection and Hemispherectomy for Epilepsy

concepts.name: Multilobar resection
concepts.blurb: Resection spanning multiple lobes for extensive epileptogenic zones, common in pediatric malformation-related epilepsy.
acgme: Multi-Lobar Resection and Hemispherectomy for Epilepsy
Pediatric Epilepsy Surgery - Hemispherectomy Multi-Lobar Resection

concepts.name: Callosotomy disconnection complications
concepts.blurb: Post-callosotomy syndromes including transient mutism, alien hand, and split-brain phenomena from interhemispheric disconnection.
acgme: Corpus Callosotomy for Epilepsy

concepts.name: Vagus nerve stimulation
concepts.blurb: Palliative left cervical vagal stimulation reducing seizure frequency when resection is unsuitable; rarely produces seizure freedom.
acgme: Vagus Nerve Stimulator (VNS) Implantation

concepts.name: VNS implantation technique
concepts.blurb: Left vagus nerve exposed within the carotid sheath; left side chosen to minimize cardiac bradyarrhythmia risk.
acgme: Vagus Nerve Stimulator (VNS) Implantation
VNS Implantation in Pediatric Patients

concepts.name: Responsive neurostimulation
concepts.blurb: Closed-loop cortical/depth system detects epileptiform activity and delivers responsive stimulation at one or two seizure foci.
acgme: Responsive Neurostimulation (RNS) System

concepts.name: DBS of anterior nucleus of thalamus
concepts.blurb: Open-loop thalamic stimulation (SANTE trial) reduces seizures in drug-resistant focal epilepsy, especially temporal onset.
acgme: Responsive Neurostimulation (RNS) System

concepts.name: Epilepsy neuromodulation selection
concepts.blurb: Choosing VNS, RNS, or DBS-ANT by focus number, localizability, eloquence, and need for chronic monitoring.
acgme: Responsive Neurostimulation (RNS) System

concepts.name: Basal ganglia motor circuitry
concepts.blurb: Direct and indirect cortico-basal-ganglia-thalamic loops whose imbalance underlies hypo- and hyperkinetic movement disorders.
acgme: Basal Ganglia Circuitry and Surgical Target Anatomy (STN GPi VIM)
Basal Ganglia - Anatomy Direct or Indirect Pathways and Clinical Correlates

concepts.name: Parkinson disease pathophysiology
concepts.blurb: Nigrostriatal dopaminergic degeneration with Lewy bodies, causing bradykinesia, rigidity, and rest tremor.
acgme: Parkinson Disease - Medical Management and Surgical Candidacy

concepts.name: Parkinson medical management
concepts.blurb: Levodopa and dopamine agonists control symptoms; motor fluctuations and dyskinesia signal candidacy for surgery.
acgme: Parkinson Disease - Medical Management and Surgical Candidacy

concepts.name: Parkinson DBS candidacy
concepts.blurb: CAPSIT criteria: levodopa-responsive PD with fluctuations or dyskinesia, no major cognitive or psychiatric contraindication.
acgme: Parkinson Disease - Medical Management and Surgical Candidacy

concepts.name: Subthalamic nucleus DBS
concepts.blurb: STN stimulation for Parkinson disease enables larger medication reduction; carries more cognitive and mood adverse effects.
acgme: Deep Brain Stimulation for Parkinson Disease (STN GPi Targets)

concepts.name: Globus pallidus internus DBS
concepts.blurb: GPi stimulation directly suppresses dyskinesia with a favorable neuropsychiatric profile but less medication reduction than STN.
acgme: Deep Brain Stimulation for Parkinson Disease (STN GPi Targets)

concepts.name: STN vs GPi target selection
concepts.blurb: Comparable motor benefit; STN favors medication reduction, GPi favors dyskinesia control and cognitively/psychiatrically fragile patients.
acgme: Deep Brain Stimulation for Parkinson Disease (STN GPi Targets)

concepts.name: Essential tremor
concepts.blurb: Bilateral action/postural tremor of hands and head, often familial and alcohol-responsive, distinct from parkinsonian rest tremor.
acgme: Deep Brain Stimulation for Essential Tremor (VIM Target)

concepts.name: VIM thalamic DBS
concepts.blurb: Stimulation of the ventral intermediate thalamic nucleus controls essential and parkinsonian tremor effectively.
acgme: Deep Brain Stimulation for Essential Tremor (VIM Target)

concepts.name: Tremor differential diagnosis
concepts.blurb: Distinguishing essential (action), parkinsonian (rest), cerebellar (intention), and dystonic tremor to guide target and therapy.
acgme: Deep Brain Stimulation for Essential Tremor (VIM Target)

concepts.name: DBS for dystonia
concepts.blurb: GPi stimulation for primary/generalized dystonia, with benefit often delayed weeks to months after activation.
acgme: Deep Brain Stimulation for Dystonia

concepts.name: DBS lead placement technique
concepts.blurb: Stereotactic frame-based or frameless targeting with MRI planning and intraoperative verification to place leads accurately.
acgme: DBS Electrode Placement - Stereotactic Frame and Lead Technique

concepts.name: Microelectrode recording
concepts.blurb: Intraoperative single-unit recording confirms target nucleus by characteristic firing patterns to refine lead trajectory.
acgme: Microelectrode Recording Interpretation During DBS Placement

concepts.name: DBS programming basics
concepts.blurb: Adjusting contact, amplitude, pulse width, and frequency to maximize benefit and avoid stimulation-induced side effects.
acgme: DBS Electrode Placement - Stereotactic Frame and Lead Technique

concepts.name: DBS hardware complications
concepts.blurb: Infection, lead migration or fracture, erosion, and hemorrhage; infection often mandates hardware removal and revision.
acgme: DBS Electrode Revision and Complication Management

concepts.name: MRgFUS thalamotomy
concepts.blurb: Incisionless MRI-guided focused ultrasound lesioning of VIM for medication-refractory tremor, typically unilateral.
acgme: Focused Ultrasound Thalamotomy (MRgFUS) for Tremor

concepts.name: Pallidotomy and thalamotomy lesioning
concepts.blurb: Radiofrequency ablation of GPi or VIM; historically primary therapy, now reserved when DBS is unsuitable.
acgme: Deep Brain Stimulation for Parkinson Disease (STN GPi Targets)

concepts.name: DBS for Tourette syndrome
concepts.blurb: Investigational thalamic (CM-Pf) or pallidal stimulation for severe refractory tics in carefully selected adults.
acgme: DBS for Tourette Syndrome and OCD

concepts.name: Trigeminal neuralgia
concepts.blurb: Paroxysmal lancinating facial pain in trigeminal distribution, usually from neurovascular compression at the root entry zone.
acgme: Trigeminal Neuralgia - Diagnosis and Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: Trigeminal neuralgia classification
concepts.blurb: Classical (neurovascular compression), secondary (MS, tumor), and idiopathic categories guiding workup and treatment.
acgme: Trigeminal Neuralgia - Diagnosis and Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: Trigeminal neuralgia medical management
concepts.blurb: Carbamazepine or oxcarbazepine is first-line; failure or intolerance prompts surgical or ablative referral.
acgme: Trigeminal Neuralgia - Diagnosis and Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: Microvascular decompression for TN
concepts.blurb: Retrosigmoid Jannetta procedure interposing material between vessel and trigeminal root; most durable, non-destructive TN treatment.
acgme: Trigeminal Neuralgia - Diagnosis and Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: MVD outcomes and durability
concepts.blurb: High initial pain relief with durable long-term control; recurrence and complications like hearing loss inform consent.
acgme: Trigeminal Neuralgia - Diagnosis and Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: Percutaneous trigeminal rhizotomy
concepts.blurb: Foramen ovale ablation by balloon compression, glycerol, or radiofrequency; faster relief but more sensory loss than MVD.
acgme: Percutaneous Trigeminal Procedures (Rhizolysis Balloon Compression Glycerol)

concepts.name: Radiosurgery for trigeminal neuralgia
concepts.blurb: Stereotactic radiosurgery to the trigeminal root; least invasive option with delayed onset and risk of facial numbness.
acgme: Radiosurgery for Trigeminal Neuralgia

concepts.name: Trigeminal neuralgia in multiple sclerosis
concepts.blurb: Demyelinating plaque at the pontine root entry zone; often bilateral and less responsive to MVD.
acgme: Trigeminal Neuralgia - Diagnosis and Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: Atypical facial pain
concepts.blurb: Constant, poorly localized facial pain lacking trigger zones; responds poorly to ablative surgery, demanding diagnostic caution.
acgme: Trigeminal Neuralgia - Diagnosis and Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: Glossopharyngeal neuralgia
concepts.blurb: Paroxysmal throat/ear pain triggered by swallowing; may cause syncope and is treated by MVD of CN IX.
acgme: Hemifacial Spasm - Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: Hemifacial spasm
concepts.blurb: Involuntary unilateral facial muscle contractions from CN VII neurovascular compression, treated by botulinum toxin or MVD.
acgme: Hemifacial Spasm - Microvascular Decompression

concepts.name: Gate control theory
concepts.blurb: Melzack-Wall model: large-fiber input modulates dorsal horn transmission, providing the rationale for spinal cord stimulation.
acgme: Pain Pathways - Spinothalamic Tract and Gate Control Theory

concepts.name: Neuropathic pain pharmacology
concepts.blurb: Gabapentinoids, tricyclics, and SNRIs are first-line agents for neuropathic pain before interventional escalation.
acgme: Neuropathic Pain Pharmacology (Gabapentinoids TCAs SNRIs)

concepts.name: Spinal cord stimulation indications
concepts.blurb: Dorsal column stimulation for failed back surgery syndrome and CRPS after failed conservative therapy.
acgme: Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) - Lead Placement and Programming

concepts.name: SCS trial stimulation
concepts.blurb: Percutaneous trial period verifies adequate pain relief and function before committing to permanent implantation.
acgme: Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) - Lead Placement and Programming

concepts.name: SCS stimulation waveforms
concepts.blurb: Tonic (paresthesia-based), burst, and high-frequency HF10 paradigms differ in paresthesia and comparative efficacy.
acgme: Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) - Lead Placement and Programming

concepts.name: SCS lead selection
concepts.blurb: Percutaneous leads allow awake trial and easy placement; surgical paddle leads offer stability and lower energy use.
acgme: SCS Lead Selection - Paddle vs Percutaneous Leads

concepts.name: Dorsal root ganglion stimulation
concepts.blurb: Targeted DRG stimulation excels for focal neuropathic pain like CRPS, where dorsal column SCS performs less well.
acgme: Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) - Lead Placement and Programming

concepts.name: Intrathecal drug delivery pump
concepts.blurb: Implanted pump delivers intrathecal analgesics, achieving effect at fractional oral dosing with fewer systemic effects.
acgme: Intrathecal Drug Delivery - Catheter and Pump Implantation

concepts.name: Intrathecal analgesic agents
concepts.blurb: Morphine and ziconotide for pain, baclofen for spasticity; choice and titration follow PACC consensus guidance.
acgme: Intrathecal Drug Delivery - Catheter and Pump Implantation

concepts.name: Catheter tip granuloma
concepts.blurb: Inflammatory mass at the intrathecal catheter tip, often dose/concentration-related, that can cause progressive neurologic deficit.
acgme: Intrathecal Drug Delivery - Catheter and Pump Implantation

concepts.name: Anterolateral cordotomy
concepts.blurb: Interruption of the spinothalamic tract for unilateral cancer pain below the neck, classically percutaneous at C1-C2.
acgme: Cordotomy for Cancer Pain

concepts.name: DREZ lesioning
concepts.blurb: Ablation of the dorsal root entry zone for deafferentation pain such as brachial plexus avulsion.
acgme: Dorsal Root Entry Zone (DREZ) Lesioning for Deafferentation Pain

concepts.name: Midline myelotomy
concepts.blurb: Midline or punctate dorsal column myelotomy interrupts a visceral pain pathway for refractory pelvic/abdominal cancer pain.
acgme: Cordotomy for Cancer Pain

concepts.name: Anterior cingulotomy for pain
concepts.blurb: Stereotactic lesion of anterior cingulate targeting the affective dimension of refractory cancer or diffuse pain.
acgme: Cordotomy for Cancer Pain

concepts.name: Cancer pain treatment algorithm
concepts.blurb: Stepwise WHO ladder escalating to intrathecal therapy and ablative procedures for refractory malignant pain.
acgme: Cancer Pain - Interventional Options and WHO Ladder

concepts.name: Complex regional pain syndrome
concepts.blurb: Disproportionate regional pain with autonomic, sensory, and motor changes; a leading indication for SCS and DRG stimulation.
acgme: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome (CRPS) - Diagnosis and Management

concepts.name: Spasticity pathophysiology
concepts.blurb: Velocity-dependent hypertonia from loss of upper-motor-neuron inhibition, seen in cerebral palsy, spinal injury, and stroke.
acgme: Surgical Management of Spasticity (ITB Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy)

concepts.name: Intrathecal baclofen pump
concepts.blurb: Implanted pump delivers intrathecal baclofen for diffuse, generalized spasticity, including lower-limb and trunk involvement.
acgme: Surgical Management of Spasticity (ITB Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy)

concepts.name: Selective dorsal rhizotomy
concepts.blurb: Sectioning of abnormal dorsal rootlets to permanently reduce lower-limb spasticity, classically in ambulatory spastic diplegic cerebral palsy.
acgme: Surgical Management of Spasticity (ITB Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy)

concepts.name: ITB vs SDR selection
concepts.blurb: SDR offers permanent benefit for focal ambulatory lower-limb spasticity; ITB suits diffuse, severe, or progressive spasticity.
acgme: Surgical Management of Spasticity (ITB Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy)

concepts.name: Botulinum toxin for spasticity
concepts.blurb: Targeted chemodenervation of overactive muscles provides temporary focal spasticity relief, often bridging to surgical therapy.
acgme: Surgical Management of Spasticity (ITB Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy)

concepts.name: Intrathecal baclofen complications
concepts.blurb: Abrupt baclofen withdrawal causes life-threatening rebound spasticity and autonomic instability; overdose causes respiratory depression and coma.
acgme: Surgical Management of Spasticity (ITB Selective Dorsal Rhizotomy)

concepts.name: DBS for obsessive-compulsive disorder
concepts.blurb: Stimulation of ventral capsule/ventral striatum or related targets for severe treatment-refractory OCD under humanitarian device exemption.
acgme: DBS for Tourette Syndrome and OCD

concepts.name: Anterior capsulotomy
concepts.blurb: Ablative lesion of the anterior limb of the internal capsule (radiofrequency or gamma) for refractory OCD.
acgme: DBS for Tourette Syndrome and OCD

concepts.name: DBS for depression
concepts.blurb: Investigational stimulation of subcallosal cingulate (area 25) or other nodes for severe treatment-resistant depression.
acgme: DBS for Tourette Syndrome and OCD

concepts.name: Ethics of psychosurgery
concepts.blurb: Lessons from the lobotomy era mandate rigorous selection, multidisciplinary oversight, and informed consent for modern psychiatric neurosurgery.
acgme: DBS for Tourette Syndrome and OCD

concepts.name: Stereotactic radiosurgery principles
concepts.blurb: Precisely focused high-dose radiation with steep falloff ablates targets while sparing adjacent tissue.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Dose and fractionation concepts
concepts.blurb: Single-fraction radiosurgery versus hypofractionated regimens balances tumor control against normal-tissue tolerance for larger or eloquent targets.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Radiosurgery platform comparison
concepts.blurb: Gamma Knife, LINAC, and CyberKnife differ in fixation, fractionation flexibility, and extracranial reach but share radiobiologic goals.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Functional radiosurgery indications
concepts.blurb: Radiosurgery applications span trigeminal neuralgia, tremor, epilepsy, AVMs, and metastases as a noninvasive ablative option.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Focused ultrasound applications
concepts.blurb: MRI-guided focused ultrasound enables incisionless ablation and transient blood-brain-barrier opening for drug delivery.
acgme: Focused Ultrasound Thalamotomy (MRgFUS) for Tremor

concepts.name: Closed-loop neurostimulation
concepts.blurb: Adaptive stimulation senses biomarkers and modulates therapy in real time, extending RNS principles to movement disorders.
acgme: Responsive Neurostimulation (RNS) System

concepts.name: Brain-computer interface
concepts.blurb: Implanted electrode arrays decode neural activity to restore communication or movement in paralysis.
acgme: Intraoperative Cortical Mapping (Motor Language) for Epilepsy or Tumor
